description: This file defines a utility function to initialize standard callback dynamic parameters for a machine learning or processing pipeline. It reads configuration from optional keyword arguments, retrieves secret strings if specified with environment variables, and populates a data class with these parameters.

classes.name: StandardCallbackDynamicParams
classes.description: A data class used to store dynamic parameters for callbacks, with annotations providing attribute types.

methods.name: StandardCallbackDynamicParams initialize_standard_callback_dynamic_params( kwargs: Optional[Dict] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes a StandardCallbackDynamicParams object with values from optional kwargs, resolving secrets from environment variables where specified.
